source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1883 consistently targets GB RTM1–RTM8 with an NVGPU association. Missing semantics are owner inputs; the same-code PSU fan row is isolated by source identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive eight-channel check is identifiable after owner-supplied RTM and GPU mapping under ED-35/36.

review_improvement: Separates PSU fan scope and binds every RTM channel to stable GPU hardware and an explicit sensing source, preventing enumeration drift or proxy telemetry from yielding a false verdict.
independent_technical_reasoning: BMC and NVGPU enumerate devices independently, so RTM index equality cannot prove GPU identity. Serial/UUID/BDF mapping plus sensor-source semantics are necessary to distinguish a BMC proxy from the driver's junction value and apply the correct thermal limits.
